features: Fix GitHub Actions 35-minute cancellation by raising the sync job timeout to 90 minutes.
Resume-aware R2 kline sync skips symbols already cached within 10 hours instead of restarting the full universe.
Current monitor watchlist symbols are always prioritized first, so actively watched symbols become usable before the full universe completes.
New listings with fewer than 30 daily bars are skipped immediately instead of wasting repeated retries.
Pionex request pacing increased to 0.85 seconds with shorter adaptive 429 cooldowns.
Dynamic Pionex SPOT/PERP monitor, R2-synced watchlist, sortable columns, live WebSocket prices and 10-second cell-only updates remain unchanged.
